name: Bandage Arcane
description: Subtle healing while a character bandages a forearm (arcane, blue): thin soft ribbons spiral round the arm and lift off, faint motes rise and the wrap glows. Attach at the forearm centre, arm along X; loops while the bandage lasts.

loop.note: Hold the heal for as long as the bandage lasts by keeping effect time inside the healing phase: every keyframe track repeats exactly every 3 s there and the emitters run at constant or periodic rates, so a runtime wraps time from 5 s back to 2 s while the simulation keeps stepping. When the bandage is done, stop wrapping and let time run on into the finish at 6.75 s (everything from 5 s to 6.75 s continues the same periodic cycle, so a runtime may also jump from any hold time t to t + 3 s to finish sooner); the effect ends by itself at 8.95 s.

attachment.notes: Attach the `anchor` node (the effect origin) to a forearm socket at the centre of the wrapped segment, with the forearm along the anchor's local X axis and local +Y up, and let it follow the arm. Nothing is drawn for the arm, the bandage or the character. Scale for thicker or thinner limbs with the Limb size control.

metadata.analysis: start 0-0.5 the first ribbon curls onto the forearm, the wrap glow and the motes fade in | wrap 0.5-2 the other ribbons join | healing 2-6.75 (held loop, 3 s cycle) one or two thin ribbons wind along the arm as an open spring of about two turns and lift gently off it, the wrap glows faintly and breathes, faint motes rise slowly | finish 6.75-7.55 the ribbon in flight brightens briefly, unwinds and rises off the arm as it dissolves, the wrap glow swells, a small puff of motes lifts off | complete the last motes rise and fade
